requirements.rule: Art. 10 p. 49: the 65% credit of the apprenticeship for the seniority increments of the worker kept on.
requirements.remediation: Credit 65% of the apprenticeship to the seniority.

requirements.rule: Art. 58 bis and Art. 55 bis: the child sickness indemnity from 2027 and the oncological permits.
requirements.remediation: Model the indemnity of Art. 58 bis and the permits of Art. 55 bis.

requirements.rule: Art. 48: the elemento perequativo of 485 EUR a year with the June pay in firms without second-level bargaining.
requirements.remediation: Add an employer fact for the second-level bargaining and pay the element.

requirements.rule: Art. 23: flessibilità beyond 40 hours (15%/20%) and banca ore (50% of the overtime premium).
requirements.remediation: Model the flexibility and hours-bank premiums.

requirements.rule: The Fondapi base ('retribuzione FONDAPI', Art. 50 p. 123) counts, besides the minimi conglobati, the EDR, the indennità di funzione of the quadri and the elemento retributivo of the 8th and 9th categories. The CCNL text sets no EDR amount and no elemento retributivo; the indennità di funzione (Art. 98 p. 182: 69.72 quadri A, 49.06 quadri B, 32.75 quadri B oreficeria) is not held by the bundle pay, so the fund contributions of an enrolled quadro are understated.
requirements.remediation: Model the quadri of the 8th and 9th categories with the indennità di funzione of Art. 98 and add it to the Fondapi base, then remove this note.

requirements.rule: Renewal of 4 June 2026: the IPCA top-up of June 2027 and 2028 above 2.653% and 2.729%.
requirements.remediation: Model the IPCA top-up when the index is published.

requirements.rule: Art. 29 rows b, d, h, i, f, m: the ordinary night premiums, the shift-worker column (night overtime 40%/45%, night holiday overtime 65%) and night holiday work within 8 hours (60%). The holiday premium (55%) and the compensatory-rest premium (10%) are modelled (supplement_bands CONFAPI_FESTIVO, CONFAPI_FESTIVO_RIPOSO) (review of 2026-10-30).
requirements.remediation: Model the remaining Art. 29 premiums: ordinary night work and the shift-worker column.

requirements.rule: LEAVE, CONTO ORE (Art. 22): the PAR not taken in the year go to an individual conto ore for 24 more months and are then paid with the retribuzione in atto. The engine carries the balances and does not pay them at the end of the window.
requirements.remediation: Pay the residual PAR of a year at the end of its 24-month conto ore window.

requirements.rule: LEAVE, PAR (Artt. 21-22 and renewal of 4 June 2026, p. 18): 8 more hours in the sectors listed by Art. 21 and for the turnisti on 15 or more shifts a week; 4 more hours from 1 January 2027 to 31 December 2028 in the companies with at least 50 employees per unità produttiva and from 2029 in every company (the sentence is an insertion of the scan, read by OCR). The engine accrues the 104 hours of the generalità.
requirements.remediation: Add employment facts for the sector, the shift pattern and the size of the unità produttiva, and the 2027 hours.

requirements.rule: The run reads an INPS ruleset marked provisional: the INPS circulars of its year are not published yet, so the rates, the massimale and the minimale (and the hourly contributions of domestic work) are those of the year before, carried over. The indexed amounts change every January: the carried-over values understate them.
requirements.remediation: Replace each provisional INPS ruleset of the year with the values of the INPS circulars of the year, drop its provisional flag, then resolve this limitation.

requirements.rule: The run reads a tax ruleset marked provisional: the sources of its year are not published yet (budget law of the year; regional and municipal surtax resolutions), so the values are those of the year before, carried over. Rules in force by statute (the IRPEF brackets of art. 11 and the deductions of art. 13 of the testo unico of D.Lgs. 117/2026) carry over unchanged; any change of the budget law is not applied.
requirements.remediation: Replace each provisional ruleset of the year with the values of its published sources, drop its provisional flag, then resolve this limitation.

requirements.rule: Art. 98: the indennità di funzione of the quadri.
requirements.remediation: Model the quadri allowance with a role.

requirements.rule: The CCNL tier and the comporto are counted on the days of one episode and the relapses it continues. A CCNL that sums the sickness of separate episodes over a window (a calendar year, the last three years) can reach a lower tier or the end of the comporto earlier than the engine shows. The run is affected when an earlier episode outside the relapse chain is recorded.
requirements.calculation: ccnl_engine.sickness.day.rules (CCNL tier of a sick day)
requirements.remediation: Add the cumulation window of each CCNL to its sickness rule, with the source, and count the tier and the comporto over it.

requirements.rule: The INPS share of a sick day is the INPS rate times the CCNL daily quota of the current month, counted on the CCNL payable days, when the episode does not let the engine compute the INPS daily base: no SicknessEpisode.inps_base in its relapse chain, an operaio without the days worked or paid of the month before, an impiegato of a month not worked in full without the pay of a whole month, an unknown worker category, or a lavoratore dello spettacolo without the pay of the last daily contributions (SpettacoloSicknessBase). With the base, INPS pays its share on the retribuzione media globale giornaliera of the month before the illness and on calendar days (INPS circ. 134368/1981 point 11). The worker's total for the day is the same; the split between INPS indemnity (outside the contribution base) and employer integration may differ, and with it the contributions.
requirements.calculation: ccnl_engine.sickness.pay.handlers (INPS share of a sick day); ccnl_engine.sickness.base.rules (daily base)
requirements.remediation: Derive the base from the closing state of the engine's own runs so the caller need not state it, then resolve this limitation.

requirements.rule: Sickness: comporto prolungato (9/13.5/18 months) and its treatment, short absences counted double from the eighth in the triennio, hospital stays over 10 days and sickness over 21 days left out of the limits (60/75/90 days, at most 120), the 2026 disability extension at 50% (renewal p. 27). The net-pay gross-up is modelled (sickness_rules.net_basis) (review of 2026-10-30).
requirements.remediation: Model the residual sickness rules of Art. 55.

requirements.rule: Art. 33: leave on a 6-day week and the transitional extra day.
requirements.remediation: Model the leave of a 6-day week.

requirements.rule: Art. 28: reperibilità (amounts by group of levels adjusted each June) and trasferta.
The festività on a Sunday (1/26) and the 1 h 20' of the ex operai; the superminimo ex Parte prima of 11 h 10' a year (Art. 38).
requirements.remediation: Pay the Sunday holiday, the 1 h 20' and the Art. 38 superminimo.

requirements.rule: An apprentice whose TFR goes to a pension fund or to the Fondo Tesoreria takes the 0.28-point relief of D.L. 203/2005 art. 8, but not the exemption from the 0.20% Fondo di garanzia contribution of D.Lgs. 252/2005 art. 10 c. 2: no source found says whether the apprentice rate (10% of L. 296/2006 art. 1 c. 773 plus NASpI and the integration funds) holds a Fondo di garanzia share to exempt. The employer contributions of the run may be overstated by 0.20% of the INPS base.
requirements.calculation: ccnl_engine.severance.relief.services; INPS messaggio n. 5859 of 7 March 2008, par. 3 (art. 8 relief of apprentices); INPS circ. 70/2007 par. 6 (Fondo di garanzia exemption, rates 0.20% and 0.40%)
requirements.remediation: Find an INPS source on the Fondo di garanzia share of the apprentice rate, then exempt it with the other workers or record that none is due.
